notes.title: New update is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello Community!

New update is now available! Check the brand new puzzle inside.

- Added a new Change Color puzzle. Players should solve this puzzle together and fill a picture with specific colors. 
- Added a new level in Practice mode.
- Added a new system of puzzle creation. It is our internal tool and it will give us more opportunities to make content more interesting and quicker. 
- We also did a small rebalance with puzzles and gameplay. For now, there will be more unique puzzles in the session.

We keep going and plan to add more new puzzles and new features next update!

---

notes.title: Next content update is coming this week!
notes.notes:
Hello Community!

We are happy to announce the next update!

For now, we are developing several new puzzles and will be releasing one of them this week. Also, we are improving our puzzle creation system. It is an internal tool but will get us the opportunity to make new content in a quicker way from a development perspective.

notes.title: New puzzles and mechanic update
notes.notes:
Hello Community!

Check the new update with several brand new puzzles and features added inside!

- Added a new card puzzle. Try your math skills!
- Added a new wheel puzzle. It is pure logic and your attentiveness.
- Added a new interactive alarm clock in the game that will make gameplay a little bit more complex.
- Added a feedback button inside the game. Please, report a bug if you faced it or provide your ideas about game improvements if you have it!

notes.title: New Update is coming!
notes.notes:
Hello Community!

We’re happy to announce our first soonest update!

For now, we are using the Steam Friend Sessions system in the game for multiplayer. Of course, we understand that sometimes it’s tough to be with your friends at the same time in the session. So why, we have an additional matchmaking system as the first point in our roadmap. It is in development right now and we expect to release it this week!

Also, there are new puzzles we are developing right now. We expect to polish it and release next updates. 

---
